defect: receiver reset safety depends on sender quiescence
rationale: The destination reset can clear its valid history while the source retains a live item; safety is undecidable without the unstated software contract that the sender is quiesced before the destination reset and remains quiescent until reinitialization.

mutation.description: Retained independent source and destination reset controls around a reduced pipeline crossing.

provenance.adaptation: Reduced the pipeline to a source item and a destination valid synchronizer.
